profile: Cargo release defaults opt-level=3, lto=false. Evaluation timing is not dense reconstruction timing.
scene_units: arbitrary; rear plane center z=4; foreground z=3; ribbon width=0.14; no millimeter interpretation
coordinate_contract: Identical supplied frame and scale; no ICP, similarity alignment, cropping, or deletion of difficult output points.
sampling: XYZ vertices vs visible GT samples from four known 80x80 cameras, focal=110; GT has two-pixel image stride. Common zero-origin voxel grid, one centroid per occupied voxel separately for both clouds.
